summary: An official tells a job seeker what will happen to their referral and who can use it.
realLife: The House résumé bank sends applicants a receipt. A hiring office can request a résumé and contact the applicant directly, and applicants can renew a submission before it expires.
inGame: recordReferral creates a row employers read when considering applicants.
gates: The official can make a job referral.

turns.what: The official asks the job seeker to come back after the hiring office opens.
turns.pulledBy: The listed contact changed and the office needs to verify who receives referrals.
turns.writesBack: The case stays open for a confirmed contact.

turns.what: The applicant receives confirmation and asks the member which office wants an interview.
turns.pulledBy: The bank has acknowledged the résumé but no hiring office has contacted the applicant.
turns.writesBack: The member explains who can call next, and the referral record keeps the interview date blank.
